name: Kegelbahn-Buffet
kurzbeschreibung:
**Bowling Alley Buffet in Tirol** --- **

Enjoy a hearty meal after your game

** At our **Kegelbahn-Buffet in Tirol**, we combine fun and flavor! After an exciting round of bowling, treat yourself to a delicious buffet with traditional Tyrolean dishes and international favorites. **

Our Highlights

** - **Kaiserschmarrn** – fluffy, caramelized, and served with powdered sugar and fresh fruit - **Tyrolean dumplings (Kasnudeln)** with butter, cheese, or your choice of sauce - **Schlutzkrapfen** – crispy fried dumplings filled with spinach and ricotta - **Freshly baked bread** and **Obatzda** – the ultimate Bavarian cheese spread - **Cold cuts & cheeses** from local producers - **Salads & fresh vegetables** for a lighter option - **Sweet temptations** – from **Apfelstrudel** to **Sachertorte** **

Drinks for Every Occasion

** - **Tyrolean beer** (Stiegl, Augustiner, or local craft brews) - **Apfelmost** (Tyrolean apple cider) and **Schnaps** (for the brave!) - **Soft drinks & juices** for the whole family - **Coffee & tea** to round off your meal **

Location & Opening Hours

** Our **Kegelbahn-Buffet** is conveniently located near **[insert location, e.g., Innsbruck, Kitzbühel, or Lienz]**, making it the perfect stop after your bowling session. **Opening times:** - **Monday–Friday:** 11:00 AM – 11:00 PM - **Weekends & holidays:** 10:00 AM – midnight **

Come Bowling & Dining with Us!

** Whether you're a local or a visitor, our **Kegelbahn-Buffet** in Tirol offers the perfect mix of **fun, food, and Tyrolean hospitality**. Roll your way to a great meal! **Visit us online | Contact**
